=== Additional information ===
==== Supported file types ====
* FSM (''with FSM Editor'')
* BIFSM (''with FSM Editor'')
* P3D (''with Objcet Builder'')
* PAA (''with TexView'')
* PAC (''with TexView'')
* SQF (''with Poseidon Tools, when linked via [[mapFolders]]'')
* SQS (''with Poseidon Tools, when linked via [[mapFolders]]'') 
* PBO (''with BankRev, when started with the parameter -pbo'')
* TPP (''with Terrain Processor'')
